product_summary: Catalogue per own IndiaMART-hosted site neelkanthfinechem.in (Jodhpur, Rajasthan; GST 08AAMFN9883C1ZQ; Managing Partner Nitin Salecha; self-described 'Manufacturer', est. group 1958, LLP 2016): industrial minerals and pharmacopoeia-grade excipients — purified talc (BP/EP/JP/IP/USP, FSSAI), calcium carbonate, bentonite, kaolin (heavy/light IP/BP/EP/USP/JP), calamine IP/BP/USP, zinc oxide, zinc carbonate USP, magnesium carbonate/oxide/hydroxide, calcium hydroxide/oxide/sulphate, barium sulphate, magnesium stearate, calcium silicate, silica powder, gypsum, plaster of Paris (food grade), ground limestone, siliceous earth NF, di-basic calcium phosphate IP, plus herbal/gum line: guar gum, guar galactomannan, acacia, karaya gum, psyllium husk, ispaghula, senna leaf/dry extract, aloe vera powder and dry extract, and a small cosmetics line (dusting powder, clay powder, aloe vera products).
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared mineral processor; IndiaMART 'Verified Exporter' badge is a platform label, not a customs record). No trader-only signs found in the catalogue, but the very broad multi-chemistry range (minerals + gums + herbal extracts + cosmetics) is consistent with a processor-cum-trader mix — cannot be resolved from the website alone.
comment: HS 121190 (plants/seeds used in pharmacy) is CORROBORATED as a real line: psyllium husk/ispaghula, senna leaf, senna dry extract, aloe vera are listed products — exact match for that part of the declaration. HS 320611 (pigments based on titanium dioxide, >=80% TiO2) is WRONG: no titanium dioxide or any pigment appears anywhere in the catalogue; the declared 320611 most likely should be a mineral/excipient heading (e.g. 283650 calcium carbonate, 252620 talc, 281700 zinc oxide). Per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground — company is kept, code corrected to the factual range. Industry claim 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the core business is industrial minerals and pharma/cosmetics excipients (chapter 25/28/29), with only a marginal food-adjacent edge (FSSAI-grade talc/calcium carbonate/guar gum/plaster of Paris, psyllium husk as a food supplement). Correct industry: chemical raw materials / mineral processing (pharma & cosmetic excipients), not FMCG. Product lines MISSING from the declaration: the entire mineral/excipient core (talc, calcium carbonate, bentonite, kaolin, calamine, zinc oxide, magnesium salts, calcium salts, barium sulphate, magnesium stearate), the gum line (guar gum 130232, acacia 130120, karaya gum) and the herbal extracts (130219). All product data above is from the company's own catalogue page — no customs line was available to me, so every code listed is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the shipment level; the HS mapping itself is my classification of the listed goods, not a verified customs record. Sources: https://neelkanthfinechem.in (catalogue, About Us, contact block). Sub-pages /our-product-range.html and /our-products.html returned HTTP 404, so no deeper catalogue was readable. Search engines (DuckDuckGo/Searx, Google, Bing) were unavailable or returned irrelevant results, so no independent third-party catalogue was cross-checked.
